scope.experience: Prompt-based Magic Design for Presentations followed by direct editing
scope.task: Generate a short presentation from a supplied outline, edit the pages and review the design before exporting.
scope.configuration: Documented Magic Design presentation workflow, using an account with the feature. Canva AI 2.0 announcements are not assumed to be available or tested.
scope.audience_perspective: An individual making a presentation without specialist design training

conversational.rationale: Natural-language prompts initiate generation and refinement, but selecting templates and editing a visual canvas make this primarily a guided creative workflow.
conversational.uncertainty: The more conversational Canva AI 2.0 experience requires a separate availability check and assessment.

specialization.rationale: Presentation layout, sample content and visual editing provide a task-focused product experience rather than general chat.
specialization.uncertainty: Canva includes many other design formats; this profile covers presentations only.

autonomy.rationale: A high-level prompt can produce multiple drafted pages, while the user reviews, edits and chooses whether to export or share.
autonomy.uncertainty: External actions and recurring generation are excluded; the actual quality of the first draft was not measured.

accessibility.rationale: Templates and editable generated pages lower the need for professional design skills and fit a broad education/business audience.
accessibility.uncertainty: Language restrictions, quotas, account access and visual-editor usability remain constraints; no accessibility audit was conducted.

explainability.rationale: Users can inspect and modify the generated layout, but the reasons behind content and design choices are not systematically justified with evidence.
explainability.uncertainty: Editability helps control, but is not the same as explanatory transparency or factual source attribution.

provenance_notes: AI-assisted documentation review, 2026-10-18; no live product tests. Scope: Canva AI's documented Magic Design for Presentations with human editing and export; excludes announced AI 2.0 scheduling/automation. Scores are design estimates. Source: https://www.canva.com/magic-design/ .
